note: Baseline 208bbcb6 (promoted frontier 766,671,138). Ten exact or bounded changes on top of it: (1) rounds 0-3 of the locktime tail SHA block partially folded on the host from the per-sequence midstate and the run-constant W2, passed as a by-value kernel parameter (QSB_TAIL_PRE); (2) raw u,v and lazy m,sum in the packed recovery finish (QSB_LAZY_REC; 2^-223 exposure class, as the chain's lazy add); (3) second pseudo-Mersenne fold fused as z8*977+{z0,z8+977*z9} (exact rearrangement, bit-identical); (4) SqrAddSub2 adds 3*2^256 inside the z8 limb and subtracts 3K after the q terms (QSB_SAS_SPLIT3P; 3K borrow kept through z4); (5) table ordinates stored as y+(K-1)/2 so a signed load is a pure XOR (QSB_YOFF; anchor sum subtracts K-1 with a limb-1 short carry); (6) the table sign mask from one arithmetic shift, identical mask values; (7) the recovery denominator leaves X unnormalised and keeps the leaf raw (QSB_RAW_DEN; differs only for the 2^-224 class X >= p); (8) the two y-parities computed from the pre-'+a' products via par(+-(w+b) mod p) instead of two modular subtractions (QSB_PARITY_SUM; exhaustively tested at the p, 2p, 2^256 and 2^256+p boundaries, and it removes two short-carry subtractions); (9) the finish loads the two block-root records as 16-byte vectors (QSB_ROOT_V2); (10) the cofactor tree computes the block root in the same warp-multiply as the first excluded level, dropping the root level and the copy level (QSB_TREE_TOP2; every product bit-identical, 1,048,576-leaf differential test).
